**Severity Scale:**
- [ ] P0 (Critical Blocker: PHI leak, payment failure, crash on startup)
- [ ] P1 (High: Feature broken, state machine failure)
- [ ] P2 (Medium: Minor functional inconsistency, performance degradation)
- [ ] P3 (Low: Visual or typography defect)

**Module Affected:**
- [ ] Authentication
- [ ] Health Passport & QR
- [ ] Verification
- [ ] Social Feed / Reels
- [ ] Marketplace
- [ ] Payments & Ledger
- [ ] Delivery
- [ ] Communication / WebRTC
- [ ] Admin / Owner Controls

**Synthetic Test Account Used:**
- (e.g., `qa.individual.01@healthogram.test`, `qa.doctor.01@healthogram.test`)

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

**Expected Behavior:**
A clear and concise description of what should have occurred.

**Actual Behavior:**
What actually happened (including log traces or status codes).

**Device & OS:**
- Device: [e.g. Pixel 8, Galaxy S24, Redmi 10]
- OS: [e.g. Android 14, Android 12]
